records.claim: The US offered energy companies loans of up to 40 million barrels from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, the final US batch under the coordinated IEA release; the SPR held less than 284 million barrels.
records.observation: Emergency public stock is being converted into temporary refinery supply through a repayable loan mechanism.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA. A new 40-million-barrel loan offer changes the available stock-to-refiner channel; it does not imply 40 million barrels have already moved.

records.claim: Cheniere Marketing and Petrobras entered a 22-year LNG sale and purchase agreement for about 0.8 mtpa on an FOB basis.
records.observation: A long-duration contractual link now connects US LNG supply with Petrobras while leaving destination logistics to the buyer.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA. Contractual optionality and committed demand changed even though physical deliveries under the agreement are future flows.

records.claim: The EIB and BNP Paribas signed a €700 million guarantee agreement for European electricity-grid manufacturers, expected to stimulate up to €2.8 billion of real-economy investment.
records.observation: Public and bank guarantees expand financing capacity for manufacturers at a physical grid-equipment bottleneck.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA. Financial risk capacity is being converted into prospective manufacturing and grid capacity.

records.claim: China will collect an additional 55% tariff on Brazilian beef from October 1 after Brazil reached its annual 1.1 million-tonne quota.
records.observation: The same trade route crosses from quota access into a sharply more expensive market-access regime.
records.assessment: CONFIRMED DELTA. The rule is announced and date-specific; the physical trade response remains to be observed.

records.claim: Oil prices rose after Donald Trump denied willingness to ease Iran sanctions, while Middle East crude exports had recovered and Saudi East-West flows had resumed.
records.observation: Price and diplomatic headlines moved while the previously recorded logistics recovery continued.
records.assessment: NO INDEPENDENT SYSTEM DELTA. Treat the price move as response/noise unless it changes a flow, constraint, rule or durable commitment.
